name: China Electronics Technology Group Corporation 48th Research Institute
zh: 中国电子科技集团公司第四十八研究所

evidence.summary: The US Entity List names it as “China Electronics Technology Group Corporation 48th Research Institute”, one of the research institutes of China Electronics Technology Group Corporation (CETC). CETC is one of the state-owned defence-industry groups that SASTIND lists. The US Commerce Department listed it in February 2023 for supporting China’s military modernization, specifically the PLA’s aerospace programs, including airships and balloons.
It belongs to CETC, which describes itself as a key state-owned enterprise administered directly by the central government.

sources.title: Additions to the Entity List (88 FR 9389, 14 February 2023)
